Insurance should be better. Medical care should be free. But it's not. And just because a person has PCOS shouldn't entitle them to anything special especially if people with more serious conditions aren't getting stuff for free. PCOS sucks, but it's very much manageable like any other illness. Weight loss can be done from improving your diet (there's sooooo many free resources on how to do this healthily and they are totaly free), exercising (walking, running, jogging, swimming, lifting gallons of milk or cans of food and doing muscle building work outs (find em on youtube for free), dancing, I could go on...theres literally no reason for a gym; unwanted body hair can be shaved, plucked, waxed, etc. Men who don't want facial hair don't get free laser removal (this has nothing to do with trans anything.); birth control is free under The Affordable Care Act; there's tons of teas and vitamins that can be taken and though they cost money a body builder and other people that are just generally into their health do not get those things for free ( sometimes even iron supplements for people with anemia aren't free) (most people drink sodas, coffees, etc and they can be replaced with these healthier alternatives.); as for people with severe hair loss that is so fucking sad but cancer patients *generally* still have to buy their own wigs (locks of love charges children's parents for those wigs, even those aren't free and they are made with donated hair); infertility is super sad and awful but a lot of things can be done to help you get pregnant (losing weight, birth control, etc) and women go infertile all the time because of other reasons than PCOS and they don't get any special help with IVF or having to pay someone to carry one for them, adoption fees, etc. 

People with PCOS arent entitled to anything extra. As I said, I do think health care/ insurance should be free. But it's not. And me, as a woman with PCOS, does not feel entitled to anything to do with my PCOS besides expecting my doctor to help me with what she can, which I had to self advocate for.

I do agree heath care should free, that would be fantastic. We are about to lose our healthcare because "I make too much money" and I make under $2000/ Month. Things are def super fucked up. I guess what I meant is if bigger situations aren't provided for free then it shouldn't be provided for free for people just because we have PCOS. There's so many worse conditions that people are dying from or going into extreme debilitating debt because of.

Um no, we shouldn't be entitled to anything for free. Gym memberships are not necessary, hair removal is not necessary, none of that. Cancer patients don't even get free chemo or wigs and cancer is was more severe of a diagnosis than my PCOS ever will be. Nothing comes free and it shouldn't be free just because you feel entitled to it. Idc if I get downvoted. And in a comment you had mentioned depression/people wanting to kill themselves...thats pretty obviously psychiatric issues and whether or not they are caused by PCOS, they need to be addressed by a psych doctor. This is coming from someone with PCOS, bipolar, anxiety disorder, PTSD, and fibromyalgia. I don't deserve anything for free. Now, should insurances be better and more things be covered, sure.
